items.title: Mike Longo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2019
items.q: That’s why if you listen to that record with Coltrane and Coleman Hawkins, they’re playing together.

ctx.x: Well I’m envious of your experience with that and also all those fellows at the Metropole. There’s a certain thing I feel like you must absorb from those guys.

Of course. There’s a thread that runs through all of jazz, the real stuff. That’s why if you listen to that record with Coltrane and Coleman Hawkins, they’re playing together. Two totally different styles, but there’s a thread that holds them together. I would say the thread has more to do with the blues. And so all those guys, I’ve always been able to play the blues from when I first started. And so that’s the thread. Now somebody like Coltrane, he’s playing all that intervallic stuff he was playing, he’s…
